name: Delta SkyMiles® Gold American Express Card

localized_names.en: Delta SkyMiles® Gold American Express Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $0 introductory annual fee for the first year, then $150.

apr.notes: Variable APRs are based on creditworthiness and the Prime Rate; rates verified from official American Express terms dated 05/24/26. APR not visible on product page; preserved from prior terms verification.

fx_fee.notes: The Delta SkyMiles® Gold American Express Card does not have foreign transaction fees.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated by issuer; Amex generally requires good to excellent credit.

base_rate.description: 1X miles on all other eligible purchases

categories.label: Delta purchases made directly with Delta
Restaurants, including takeout and delivery in the U.S.

rewards.redemption_notes: SkyMiles program rules apply. Card Members can use Pay with Miles: take up to $50 off the cost of your ticket for every 5,000 miles you redeem when you book on delta.com.

signup_bonus.description: Welcome offer as high as 80,000 bonus miles after eligible purchases; exact offer is disclosed before accepting the Card and offers vary. Signup bonus not visible on product page; preserved from prior verification.

benefits.title: $200 Delta Flight Credit
benefits.description: After you spend $10,000 in purchases on your Card in a calendar year, you can receive a $200 Delta Flight Credit to use toward future travel.

benefits.title: $100 Delta Stays Credit
benefits.description: Get up to $100 back per year as a statement credit after using your Card to book prepaid hotels or vacation rentals through Delta Stays on delta.com.

benefits.title: $120 Rideshare Credit
benefits.description: After your first Card renewal, earn up to $10 in statement credits each month when using your Card on U.S. rideshare purchases with select providers. That's up to $120 back each year. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: First Bag Free and NEW Second Bag Free
benefits.description: Enjoy your first checked bag free on Delta flights worldwide – and on domestic Delta flights, your second bag flies free too.

benefits.title: Zone 5 Priority Boarding
benefits.description: Receive Zone 5 Priority Boarding on Delta flights; board early, stow your carry-on bag and settle in sooner.

benefits.title: TakeOff 15
benefits.description: Take 15% off anytime you book Award Travel with miles on Delta flights when using delta.com and the Fly Delta app. Discount not applicable to partner-operated flights or to taxes and fees.

benefits.title: Pay with Miles
benefits.description: Take up to $50 off the cost of your ticket for every 5,000 miles you redeem with Pay with Miles when you book on delta.com.

benefits.title: 20% Back on In-Flight Purchases
benefits.description: Receive a 20% savings in the form of a statement credit after you use your Card on eligible Delta in-flight purchases of food and beverages.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Enjoy international travel without additional fees on purchases made abroad.

benefits.title: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: When you use your Eligible Card to reserve and pay for the Entire Rental and decline the collision damage waiver (CDW), you can be covered for Damage to or Theft of a Rental Vehicle. Coverage is not available for vehicles rented in Australia, Italy, and New Zealand. This product provides secondary coverage and does not include liability coverage.

benefits.title: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen Baggage when you purchase the Entire Fare for a Common Carrier Vehicle ticket on an Eligible Card. Up to $1,250 for carry-on Baggage and up to $500 for checked Baggage. For New York State residents, there is a $10,000 aggregate maximum limit for all Covered Persons per Covered Trip.

benefits.title: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: Whenever you travel more than 100 miles from home, Global Assist Hotline is available for 24/7 emergency assistance and coordination services, including medical and legal referrals, emergency cash wires, and missing luggage assistance.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Protects covered purchases against accidental damage or theft for up to 90 days from the Covered Purchase date. Up to $1,000 per Covered Purchase, up to $50,000 per calendar year.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Up to one extra year added to the Original Manufacturer's Warranty. Applies to warranties of 5 years or less on Covered Purchases in the United States or its territories.

benefits.title: Amex Special Ticket Access
benefits.description: Card Members can access Amex Presale Tickets and Amex Reserved Tickets to select events across sports, music, and more.

benefits.title: American Express Venue Collection
benefits.description: Enjoy an enhanced experience at select stadiums and arenas with on-site benefits including dedicated entrances or fast lanes. Enroll your Card and get 10% back on qualifying concessions purchases up to $250 per calendar year.

benefits.title: Send & Split
benefits.description: Send money and split purchases with other Venmo and PayPal users, all in the American Express App. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: Year-End Summary
benefits.description: The Online Year-End Summary, typically available in January, reflects charges posted to your account from January 1st through December 31st of the prior year.

benefits.title: Additional Cards
benefits.description: You can add an Additional Card for anyone who makes purchases for you.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: First checked bag free on Delta flights worldwide; second checked bag free on domestic Delta flights.
other: Zone 5 Priority Boarding on eligible Delta flights
TakeOff 15 award travel discount on eligible Delta-operated award tickets
Pay with Miles on eligible Delta flights
